s: The students brought their notebooks to class.
def: Belonging to them. Not 'there' and not 'they're'.

s: Put the box over there by the door.
def: In that place. Not 'their' and not 'they're'.

s: The weather turned cold and rainy.
def: The condition of the air outside. Not 'whether'.

s: I cannot decide whether to go or stay.
def: A word showing a choice between options. Not 'weather'.

s: The principal of our school gave a speech.
def: The head of a school. Not 'principle'.

s: The two countries signed a treaty of peace.
def: Freedom from war or noise. Not 'piece'.

s: The knight raised his shield to block the blow.
def: A broad piece of armor held to protect the body.

s: Please read the poem aloud to the class.
def: Out loud, so others can hear. Not 'allowed'.

s: Honesty is an important principle to live by.
def: A basic rule or belief. Not 'principal'.

s: We are allowed to eat lunch outside.
def: Permitted. Not 'aloud'.

s: Paris is the capital of France.
def: A city where a government sits. Not 'capitol'.

s: The parked car stayed stationary.
def: Not moving. Not 'stationery'.

s: She bought stationery to write letters.
def: Paper and envelopes for writing. Not 'stationary'.

s: The red scarf is a complement to her coat.
def: Something that completes or goes well with. Not 'compliment'.

s: He gave her a kind compliment about her drawing.
def: A polite expression of praise. Not 'complement'.

s: Camels can cross the hot desert.
def: A dry sandy region. Not 'dessert', the sweet treat.

s: She was conscious of the noise behind her.
def: Awake and aware. Not 'conscience'.

s: He was discreet about the surprise party.
def: Careful not to reveal something. Not 'discrete'.

s: The data came in discrete groups.
def: Separate and distinct. Not 'discreet'.

s: Flowers were placed on the altar.
def: A raised table used in ceremonies. Not 'alter'.

s: We may alter the plan if it rains.
def: To change something. Not 'altar'.

s: Remember to cite the book you used.
def: To quote or name a source. Not 'site' or 'sight'.

s: The question will elicit a thoughtful answer.
def: To draw out a response. Not 'illicit'.

s: Rain will affect our picnic plans.
def: To influence something. Usually a verb, unlike 'effect'.

s: He was unhappy about losing the game.
def: Not happy.

s: Please rewrite the messy paragraph.
def: To write again.

s: We watched a preview of the movie.
def: A look at something before it is shown fully.

s: They politely disagree about the answer.
def: To have a different opinion.

s: The clock struck midnight.
def: Twelve o'clock at night.

s: His silly story was complete nonsense.
def: Words or ideas that make no sense.

s: She was unable to reach the top shelf.
def: Not able to do something.

s: We rode the subway across the city.
def: An underground train.

s: The international contest had teams from ten countries.
def: Between or among different nations.

s: Do not misunderstand what I meant.
def: To fail to understand correctly.

s: Trucks transport goods across the country.
def: To carry something from one place to another.

s: The submarine dove beneath the waves.
def: A ship that travels underwater.

s: Do not overestimate how much time is left.
def: To guess that something is larger than it is.

s: Dad poured antifreeze into the car.
def: A liquid that keeps something from freezing.

s: Multiply seven by eight to get the answer.
def: To increase a number a certain number of times.

s: Climbing that wall seemed impossible.
def: Not able to happen or be done.

s: Measure the circumference of the circle.
def: The distance around a circle.

s: Her memory for names is extraordinary.
def: Very unusual or remarkable.

s: Australia is in the southern hemisphere.
def: One half of the earth or of a sphere.

s: The two reports contradict each other.
def: To say the opposite of something.

s: Bringing an umbrella was unnecessary.
def: Not needed.

s: Try not to interrupt while she is speaking.
def: To break into someone's speech or action.

s: The microscopic creatures live in pond water.
def: So small it can only be seen with a microscope.

s: The window glass is completely transparent.
def: Clear enough to see through.

s: Be careful crossing the street.
def: Taking care to avoid mistakes or danger.

s: Her kindness made everyone feel welcome.
def: The quality of being kind.

s: He quickly finished his homework.
def: In a fast way.

s: A broken pencil is useless.
def: Having no use at all.

s: The friendly dog wagged its tail.
def: Kind and pleasant to others.

s: She reads for pure enjoyment.
def: The feeling of enjoying something.

s: That painter is famous around the world.
def: Known by many people.

s: The darkness of the cave surprised them.
def: The state of having no light.

s: This chair is very comfortable.
def: Pleasant and easy to be in.

s: She is responsible for feeding the cat.
def: Having a duty to take care of something.

s: Thin ice is dangerous to walk on.
def: Likely to cause harm.

s: That old coin is quite valuable.
def: Worth a lot of money or importance.

s: The storm caused terrible damage.
def: Very bad or awful.

s: The curious kitten explored the box.
def: Eager to learn or know something.

s: The lake was quiet and peaceful.
def: Calm and free from noise or trouble.

s: The doctor explained the treatment.
def: The care given to help someone get better.

s: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible.
def: Too tempting to refuse.

s: Our guide was knowledgeable about birds.
def: Knowing a lot about a subject.

s: A mysterious light appeared in the sky.
def: Strange and hard to explain.

s: Milk is a perishable food.
def: Likely to spoil or go bad quickly.

s: He is a conscientious student who checks his work.
def: Careful and thorough in doing what is right.

s: Studying early is advantageous before a test.
def: Giving a benefit or helpful edge.

s: There was a noticeable change in her tone.
def: Easy to see or notice.

s: They made a tremendous effort to finish.
def: Very great in size or amount.

s: I believe you told the truth.
def: To accept that something is true.

s: My best friend lives next door.
def: A person you like and trust.

s: He saved one piece of cake for later.
def: A part broken or cut from something.

s: The horses ran across the open field.
def: An open area of land.

s: The fire chief spoke to our class.
def: The leader of a group.

s: There are eight crayons in the box.
def: The number after seven.

s: My niece just turned six years old.
def: The daughter of your brother or sister.

s: The thief was caught by the police.
def: A person who steals.

s: Did you receive my letter?
def: To get something that is given or sent.

s: A spider crawled across the ceiling.
def: The upper surface inside a room.

s: Our neighbor waters our plants.
def: A person who lives next to you.

s: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
def: To succeed in doing something.

s: That was a weird dream last night.
def: Strange or unusual.

s: Measure the height of the doorway.
def: How tall something is.

s: Do not let the trick deceive you.
def: To make someone believe something untrue.

s: She is learning a foreign language.
def: From another country.

s: Can you perceive the faint sound?
def: To become aware of through the senses.

s: The new method is more efficient.
def: Working well without wasting time or effort.

s: We have sufficient supplies for the trip.
def: Enough for what is needed.

s: The bank spotted the counterfeit bill.
def: A fake copy made to fool people.

s: The eagle will seize the fish in its claws.
def: To grab something suddenly and firmly.

s: He reads during his leisure time.
def: Free time when you can relax.

s: The kittens got into mischief again.
def: Playful behavior that causes small trouble.

s: Beans are a good source of protein.
def: A nutrient the body needs to grow.

s: We stayed inside because it rained.
def: For the reason that.

s: February is the shortest month.
def: The second month of the year.

s: We have music class on Wednesday.
def: The day between Tuesday and Thursday.

s: Blue is her favorite color.
def: The one you like best.

s: These two shells are different sizes.
def: Not the same.

s: It will probably snow tonight.
def: Most likely.

s: She borrowed three books from the library.
def: A place where books are kept for borrowing.

s: Write your answer on the line.
def: A reply or solution.

s: Please separate the red beads from the blue ones.
def: To divide or keep apart.

s: I will definitely be at the game.
def: Without any doubt.

s: We ate dinner at a new restaurant.
def: A place where meals are served.

s: Mark the date on the calendar.
def: A chart showing the days of the year.

s: The government passed a new law.
def: The group that runs a country or state.

s: That song sounds familiar to me.
def: Well known or often seen before.

s: The temperature dropped below freezing.
def: A measure of how hot or cold something is.

s: Camping was a new experience for him.
def: Something you have done or lived through.

s: The waves rolled in rhythmically.
def: In a regular repeating pattern.

s: The permit was delayed by bureaucracy.
def: A system of many official rules and offices.

s: Each student filled out a questionnaire.
def: A written list of questions to answer.

s: The bridge requires yearly maintenance.
def: The work of keeping something in good condition.

s: Please acknowledge that you received the message.
def: To admit or confirm something is true.

s: He used a vacuum to clean the rug.
def: A space with no air, or a machine that sucks up dirt.

s: Driving a car is a privilege, not a right.
def: A special right or advantage.

s: The store offers a guarantee on the bike.
def: A promise that something will work or be done.
